central_claim.text: Cross-unit transfer claims require prospective qualification on the realized deployment geometry and an explicit abstention state; TTF separates method validity, deployment detectability, observational admissibility, and the authorized empirical result so that NOT_EVALUABLE is distinguishable from a qualified negative result.

claims.claim: A cross-species transfer design can fail exact-geometry error control even when a separate within-species detectability gate passes.
claims.key_statistic: development Gate-D private Wilson upper=0.1003347533 > 0.10; shared power criterion passed; separate self-detectability qualification passed
claims.interpretation: Cross-species empirical opening was not licensed on the development geometry.

claims.claim: Observational admissibility can fail after method-level qualification without licensing an ecological null result.
claims.key_statistic: 189/250 species met the frozen support minimum; no authorized empirical geometry was retained
claims.interpretation: Trait values and the empirical transfer statistic remained unopened.

claims.claim: A fresh response-blind deployment can pass the same prospective logic and authorize one empirical opening.
claims.key_statistic: 211 survivors; inherited 103 training / 108 evaluation split; private-null Wilson upper=0.0681; shared-A2 Wilson lower=0.9714

claims.claim: TTF distinguishes a qualified negative cross-species result from a design that was not evaluable.
claims.key_statistic: post-IBD transfer T=0.0325654847, p=0.7392607393; separately qualified self test p=0.008991009

claims.claim: Finite candidate families and frozen stopping rules make abstention executable rather than rhetorical.
claims.interpretation: Failed or exhausted candidate families close under their frozen confirmatory label; successors require a newly named development program.

forbidden_overclaims: TTF proves that all biologically plausible private structure has been represented by the synthetic world family.
The fresh genetic result proves that cross-species genetic transfer is exactly zero.
The significant self test is a positive raw correlation; its raw statistic is negative and inference is null-relative.
A NOT_EVALUABLE endpoint identifies the biological mechanism that caused the gate failure.
One qualified deployment validates the method for every ecological domain or sampling geometry.

primary_distinction.qualification_fail: The empirical transfer claim is not licensed under the frozen design.
primary_distinction.observational_fail: The realized data do not support the predeclared estimand.
primary_distinction.qualified_empirical_nondetection: A valid negative result within the prospectively qualified domain.
primary_distinction.qualified_empirical_detection: Evidence for transfer under the frozen estimand and declared null family.
